dialogues.speaker: Pechna
dialogues.text: Have I read this one before...? Ehh, I can't remember.

dialogues.speaker: Pechna
dialogues.text: Uhh... Books, I guess? I can't really read the hard ones, so I'm just picking up the entertaining novels with fun stories.

dialogues.speaker: Pechna
dialogues.text: But I think I've read nearly all the new arrivals, so now I'm thinking of adding old ones to my backlog.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll leave you to it then.

dialogues.speaker: Pechna
dialogues.text: Hmm? What was that? Ah, never mind...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you have any recommended reads?

dialogues.speaker: Pechna
dialogues.text: Recommended...? Uhh, sorry, I don't really know what's good or bad, or what all the plots are about, really. I'm just here to kill some time and flip some pages.

dialogues.speaker: Pechna
dialogues.text: But if I have to pick one... I'd go with "The Legends of Reed Miller, Thief Extraordinaire." The shopkeep says it's the resident bestseller.

dialogues.speaker: Pechna
dialogues.text: Since it's popular, it's probably not the worst one, which means it's still worth a read.

dialogues.speaker: Pechna
dialogues.text: Hmm, I won? Ah, thank you.

dialogues.speaker: Pechna
dialogues.text: It's my loss. Looks like you really can't take the plots in books too seriously...
